artist.name: Hadi Alkawkgi
artist.heroLine: Oil on canvas, ink on card, graphite and charcoal, etching on paper.
artist.statement: I paint the same few rooms and the same few people until they stop being familiar.
bio: Hadi Alkawkgi was born in Damascus in 2000 and graduated from Damascus University of Fine Arts in 2023.

The work moves between three materials that keep correcting each other: oil on canvas for the long paintings, Chinese ink on card for the fast studies that precede them, and printmaking — silkscreen and copper plate etching — for images that only make sense in multiples.

His graduation project, 'In Their Looks, History,' painted the older people around him — his father among them — and himself, in a realistic style close to portraiture from life. It set out to hold feelings usually left unspoken: fear, pain, sadness.

Hadi works from his own feelings and close attention to what's in front of him — how light falls on an object, the shift between a lit room and a dim one, small differences in material and technique, colour built in very small steps so it reads as almost one hue. He's drawn to darkness as a subject worth looking at closely, not away from.
